verdict.rationale: Ollama's first-party docs list an official Python library and an official JavaScript library for using Ollama from an application, which directly matches the story. Separate docs pages cover using Ollama from Python and from JavaScript/TypeScript. The evidence is short headline mentions rather than in-depth reference material. Missing for 10: detailed library documentation (install, API surface, examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of library usage.
